chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi wakes up in a hotel suite under the care of Xu Zhong, Gu Suizhou's assistant. After realizing he was being kept in the dark, Shen Feizhi escapes by jumping out a window, leaving Gu Suizhou distraught and injured. Gu Suizhou, now highly motivated to resolve the mystery of 'W.N' and secure his inheritance, begins taking aggressive steps to protect Shen Feizhi's reputation. Meanwhile, Shen Feizhi returns to Blue Star after being summoned by Elder Master Shen to assist his 'fiancée', Lu Qian, who is suffering from a pheromone-related medical crisis. Madam Lu proposes an engagement between them to facilitate treatment, which Shen Feizhi cautiously accepts.
